text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, I was simply observing
everyone hard at work with their training, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Each and every person has a goal—a dream—which
is why they are making such earnest efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We too are running toward our dreams, so we must
apply ourselves diligently as well, desu wa.
